## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has one cohesive responsibility and respects dependency direction.
- [ ] Files and functions remain within policy budgets.
- [ ] Public behavior, security, architecture, and release documentation are current.
- [ ] No proprietary host file, save, credential, personal path, or build output is included.
- [ ] No implementation source was copied; provenance and licenses are recorded.
- [ ] Runtime mutation used only an explicitly authorized disposable environment.
- [ ] Remaining risks and unverified claims are explicit.
